 "data": "%%{init: {
 \"theme\": \"base\",
 \"flowchart\": {
 \"htmlLabels\": true,
 \"curve\": \"linear\",
 \"nodeSpacing\": 12,
 \"rankSpacing\": 24,
 \"padding\": 6
 },
 \"themeVariables\": {
 \"fontFamily\": \"Arial, Microsoft YaHei, sans-serif\",
 \"fontSize\": \"12px\",
 \"primaryTextColor\": \"#000000\",
 \"lineColor\": \"#444444\",
 \"clusterBkg\": \"#ffffff\",
 \"clusterBorder\": \"#888888\"
 }
}}%%
flowchart TB
 %% =========================
 %% System Entry
 %% =========================
 IN[\"Verified Trading Strategy<br/><small>Strategy Logic · Parameter Configuration · Historical Data</small>\"]
 %% =========================
 %% Testing Orchestration Layer
 %% =========================
 subgraph ORC[\"Testing Orchestration Agent｜Orchestrator\"]
 direction TB
 O1[\"Scenario Configuration<br/><small>Test Coverage · Parameter Boundaries</small>\"]
 O2[\"Task Scheduling<br/><small>Parallel Execution · State Tracking</small>\"]
 end
 %% =========================
 %% Market Environment Simulation Layer
 %% =========================
 subgraph SIM[\"Market Environment Simulation Agent\"]
 direction TB
 subgraph SIMR1[\" \"]
 direction LR
 S1[\"Bull Market Scenario<br/><small>Upward Trend · High Activity</small>\"]
 S2[\"Bear Market Scenario<br/><small>Persistent Decline · Risk Release</small>\"]
 end
 subgraph SIMR2[\" \"]
 direction LR
 S3[\"High Volatility Scenario<br/><small>Price Jumps · Amplified Fluctuations</small>\"]
 S4[\"Liquidity Exhaustion Scenario<br/><small>Widening Spreads · Constrained Transactions</small>\"]
 end
 end
 %% =========================
 %% Risk & Deviation Analysis Layer
 %% =========================
 subgraph ANA[\"Risk & Deviation Analysis Agent\"]
 direction TB
 subgraph ANAR1[\" \"]
 direction LR
 R1[\"Risk Measurement<br/><small>VaR · Maximum Drawdown · Volatility</small>\"]
 R2[\"Stress Testing<br/><small>Extreme Losses · Risk Threshold Alerts</small>\"]
 end
 subgraph ANAR2[\" \"]
 direction LR
 B1[\"Data Bias Detection<br/><small>Survivorship Bias · Sample Bias</small>\"]
 B2[\"Evaluation Bias Detection<br/><small>Hindsight Bias · Overfitting Risk</small>\"]
 end
 end
 %% =========================
 %% Comprehensive Assessment & Deployment Gate
 %% =========================
 subgraph GATE[\"Deployment Gate Agent｜Go / No-Go\"]
 direction TB
 E1[\"Comprehensive Test Report<br/><small>Return · Risk · Robustness · Bias</small>\"]
 E2{\"Meets Deployment<br/>Criteria?\"}
 GO[\"Go<br/><small>Proceed to Deployment</small>\"]
 NOGO[\"No-Go<br/><small>Return to Strategy Optimization</small>\"]
 end
 %% =========================
 %% Main Flow
 %% =========================
 IN --> ORC
 ORC -->|Generate Test Tasks| SIM
 SIM -->|Simulation Results| R1
 SIM -->|Extreme Scenario Results| R2
 SIM -->|Sample & Data Records| B1
 SIM -->|Backtesting Process & Results| B2
 R1 --> E1
 R2 --> E1
 B1 --> E1
 B2 --> E1
 E1 --> E2
 E2 -->|Yes| GO
 E2 -->|No| NOGO
 NOGO -.->|Adjust Parameters or Strategy| IN
 %% =========================
 %% Node Styles
 %% =========================
 classDef input fill:#ffffff,stroke:#444444,stroke-width:1.3px,color:#000000;
 classDef orchestrator fill:#ffffff,stroke:#888888,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#000000;
 classDef simulation fill:#ffffff,stroke:#444444,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#000000;
 classDef analysis fill:#ffffff,stroke:#888888,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#000000;
 classDef gate fill:#ffffff,stroke:#888888,stroke-width:1.2px,color:#000000;
 classDef decision fill:#ffffff,stroke:#444444,stroke-width:1.4px,color:#000000;
 classDef pass fill:#ffffff,stroke:#444444,stroke-width:1.3px,color:#000000;
 classDef reject fill:#ffffff,stroke:#444444,stroke-width:1.3px,color:#000000;
 class IN input;
 class O1,O2 orchestrator;
 class S1,S2,S3,S4 simulation;
 class R1,R2,B1,B2 analysis;
 class E1 gate;
 class E2 decision;
 class GO pass;
 class NOGO reject;

 style SIMR1 fill:none,stroke:none
 style SIMR2 fill:none,stroke:none
 style ANAR1 fill:none,stroke:none
 style ANAR2 fill:none,stroke:none",
